summary.text: Jeffrey R. Graham is a Democratic member of the South Carolina Senate for District 35, which covers Kershaw, Lee, Richland and Sumter Counties.
His official page lists his occupation as real estate and says he was mayor of Camden from 2008 to 2012.

paragraphs.text: Graham was born on May 14, 1982, in Camden, and earned a B.S. from Presbyterian College in 2004.
He was mayor of Camden from 2008 to 2012 and served on the Camden City Council from 2014 to 2024.
His page lists him as president of the Association of S.C. Mayors and a member of the Kershaw County Chamber of Commerce.
His committee assignments are Agriculture and Natural Resources, Family and Veterans' Services, Fish, Game and Forestry, and Judiciary.
